listing.name: Project Gotham Racing 3 — pgr3 (stuken)
listing.summary: A game-specific build and runtime exist. Complete progression has not been established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Project Gotham Racing 3 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 4D5307D1 plus TU0.0.5.1 default.xexp; this guide does not include the MD5 values for the original executable and title-update file. Check the project’s exact original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build SDK, dump own TU-patched PGR3 image, generate code/shaders and compile Windows runtime.
